acceptance.accepted_history_rule: Only the event exactly anchored by CURRENT.latest_event commit+path+digest is accepted history.
acceptance.canonicalization_gate: Reject repeated decoded member names before object construction. Do not silently Unicode-normalize member names in the canonical serializer. If a declared application profile normalizes names, normalize first and reject post-normalization collisions before canonicalization, idempotency derivation, or hashing.
acceptance.duplicate_rule: Existing deterministic claim path is DUPLICATE; do not replace claim, outbox, event, or CURRENT.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Fetch CURRENT again; it must remain exact v74/blob 4e7298b82dad28214e3a76c56e3401dac7bd30cc/stored projection digest 5ccf4b7e4591db5a972d1611bf53e8698ccdacbf587e933ba2bca86a485a38be before one blob-SHA-guarded replacement; final readback must be v75.
acceptance.slack_gate: Slack post is prohibited before exact v75 readback anchors this event commit+path+digest; then post one sanitized exact-marker pointer and append one immutable delivery receipt.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: This is one local Python JSON parser, one local canonical serializer, and one Unicode NFC implementation. It does not prove RFC 8785, cross-language, Unicode-version, streaming-parser, or producer conformance. The controlled specimen exercises one top-level precomposed-versus-decomposed member-name pair only; nested objects, supplementary-plane characters, non-NFC profiles, UTF-16 sort differences, and independent implementations remain untested. Treating canonically equivalent Unicode names as distinct may be correct for JSON but unsafe for application domains that visually or semantically identify them; any normalization profile must be explicit and collision-rejecting. Claim, outbox, event, CURRENT replacement, Slack post, and delivery receipt are separate effects. Git supplies branch-local create-only paths and a single-file prior-blob-SHA replacement precondition only; it provides no cross-file transaction, database uniqueness or isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, force-push safety, cross-branch exclusion, or Slack atomicity.

probe.name: JSON_UNICODE_NORMALIZATION_COLLISION_POLICY_V1

operation_payload.controlled_factor: Vary only whether two decoded JSON member names are canonically equivalent under Unicode NFC while remaining different code-point sequences. Keep values, UTF-8 encoding, duplicate-decoded-name gate, restricted integer values, canonical serializer, object version chain, and write protocol fixed.
operation_payload.hypothesis: Canonicalization must not silently normalize member names. If an application requires NFC-normalized names, normalization must occur at a declared ingress policy that rejects post-normalization collisions before object construction, idempotency derivation, or hashing.

measured_result.result: The local parser preserved precomposed U+00E9 and decomposed U+0065 U+0301 as distinct member names, and the canonical serializer produced distinct bytes from the normalized single-member control. A declared NFC-normalizing ingress detected both names mapping to 'é' and rejected the collision rather than applying last-wins.

native_task_read.title: HFO X12 Durable Object PDCA Lab

operation_payload.result_contract: Record local code-point and NFC behavior exactly. Do not normalize silently in the canonical serializer. Any normalization profile must be explicit, domain-bound, and collision-rejecting before canonicalization; do not claim RFC 8785 or cross-language conformance.

probe.strongest_falsifier: A replay shows the two member names are not code-point distinct or not NFC-equivalent; the ordinary parser or canonical bytes differ from the recorded result; the declared NFC gate fails to reject the post-normalization collision; raw or canonical digests fail recomputation; the deterministic claim already existed but state still advances; CURRENT is not exact v74 on the second read; or final event/CURRENT binding fails.

canonical_transition.rollback: Never delete the claim, outbox, event, Slack message, or receipt. If v75 is later invalid, append a compensating transition from the then-current exact version. Change Unicode normalization policy only through a later versioned event that binds the selected profile and collision behavior.
